title: PROMPTS NAME THE KEY YOU SET
why: Found by the code comb of 2026-10-07: since CHANGE KEYS (v17.75) any action can move to another key, but on the keyboard the prompts drawn on screen (search, take, open, extract, revive: 16 of them name E) and the Undercroft footer still said the default key, so after moving interact the game kept telling you to press E. They now name the key the action is on; with nothing changed they read exactly as before.
now: After you move a key in CHANGE KEYS, the on-screen prompts name the new key.
